name: qhud
description: Session status lines (renamed from tcw): model, effort and fallback chain, git status, context fill and usage limits (5h / weekly / per-model weekly), under or above the prompt

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: band: 2–3 coloured lines above the prompt; bottom: the same lines under the prompt; line: one status line under the prompt

style.title: Band style
style.description: plain: coloured text; chip: each line on a shaded background; box: one rounded frame

model.title: Show model
model.description: Show the model, its effort and the fallback chain (Opus 5.5 · high · ⤷ Sonnet › Haiku)

weather.title: Show context fill
weather.description: Show the context window fill, CT 34%, after git

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last response (1h or 5m)

git.title: Show git status
git.description: Show branch, ahead/behind and changed files (runs git status, no tokens)

plan.title: Show per-model weekly limits
plan.description: Also show model-specific weekly windows such as 7d Fable, read from the account usage endpoint every 5 minutes (no tokens)
